trust.en: would they put things in your hands

intimacy.zh: 恋爱的进展，只有产品允许的人物才有
intimacy.en: romance; only characters the product allows

premise.zh: galgame 式的恋爱故事：读剧情、看人，在关键处做选择。好感藏在后台，只从对方的态度里感觉得到；共通线走完，按好感进入某个人的线。好玩在“当时随手的一句话，后来才知道有多重”。
premise.en: A visual-novel romance: read, watch the characters, choose at the key moments. Affection stays hidden and shows only in how they treat you; after the common route, affection decides whose route you enter. The fun is learning later how much a passing remark weighed.

risk.zh: 误会、流言：说错话、做错事积下来的。到线必须出事（一场误会、一次冷战），不能只是一个数字。
risk.en: Misunderstanding, rumor: what careless words and deeds pile up. Crossing the line must cause something (a misunderstanding, a cold spell), not just change a number.

time.zh: 剩下的日子：离某个期限（毕业、拆迁、离开）还有多久。
time.en: Days left: how long until a deadline (graduation, demolition, a departure).

keepsake.zh: 信物、回忆：一起做过的事留下的东西，后面会在关键时刻用上。
keepsake.en: Keepsakes and memories: what shared moments leave behind, used later at a key moment.

failures.zh: 错过：该开口的时候没有开口
failures.en: Missed: you didn't speak when it mattered

failures.zh: 误会：一句话被听成了另一个意思
failures.en: Misunderstood: one remark heard as something else

failures.zh: 普通结局：谁都不够亲近，春天就这样过去了
failures.en: Normal ending: no one close enough, and the season simply passes

checklist.zh: 所有角色都是成年人；纯爱，不写露骨内容
checklist.en: Every character is an adult; romance stays non-explicit

checklist.zh: 好感不显示数字，只体现在台词、表情和后面的走向上
checklist.en: Affection is never shown as a number; only in lines, expressions and what follows

checklist.zh: 分歧点总有一条路可走：谁都不够时进普通结局，不卡死
checklist.en: Every branch point has a way forward: if no one is close enough, the normal ending, never a dead end

checklist.zh: 每条个人线都有好结局和普通结局，通关全部个人线后开启真结局
checklist.en: Every route has a good and a normal ending; clearing all routes opens the true ending

label.zh: 对知遥说“来看它最后一个春天”
label.en: Told Zhiyao he came to see its last spring
Joined the film club

label.zh: 在沈澄的店里点了小时候那杯
label.en: Ordered his childhood drink at Shen Cheng's café

label.zh: 看见了那盘没有标签的胶片
label.en: Saw the unlabeled reel
Sold grandfather's old posters for charity
Learned about Zhiyao's mother
Ji Bai became the third member
Shen Cheng became the third member
Cheng Hang became the third member
Knows Zhiyao is going home after graduation
Remembered the promise from seven years ago

label.zh: 答应和季白一起看第七卷
label.en: Promised to watch reel seven with Ji Bai
Entered Zhiyao's route
Entered Shen Cheng's route
Entered Ji Bai's route
Went home alone on the eve

persona.zh: 夏知遥：21 岁，汐川大学大三，电影社社长。明亮、嘴快、固执，一个人撑着快解散的社团；毕业后要去外地照顾生病的母亲，这件事谁也没告诉。叫主角“陆远”，熟了以后叫“喂”。
persona.en: Xia Zhiyao: 21, a third-year at Xichuan University and president of the film club. Bright, quick-tongued, stubborn; holding a dying club together alone. After graduation she must move away to care for her sick mother, and she has told no one. Calls the protagonist 'Lu Yuan', later just 'hey'.

persona.zh: 沈澄：21 岁，主角的青梅竹马，留在汐川，一边读书一边在家里的海边咖啡馆帮忙。对主角冷淡、话少；七年前他走的那天，他们有一个约，她记得，他忘了。叫主角“陆远”，从不叫小名。
persona.en: Shen Cheng: 21, the protagonist's childhood friend who stayed in Xichuan, studying while helping at her family's seaside café. Cool and curt with him. Seven years ago, on the day he left, they made a promise; she remembers, he forgot. Calls him 'Lu Yuan', never his childhood nickname.

persona.zh: 季白：23 岁，研究生，潮声影院的兼职放映员，整天在放映室修老胶片。安静、说话准确、爱用电影打比方；仓库里有一盘没有标签的胶片，她一直没敢放。叫主角“陆同学”。
persona.en: Ji Bai: 23, a graduate student and part-time projectionist at the Tidesound Cinema, forever restoring old film in the booth. Quiet, precise, fond of film metaphors. In the storeroom there is an unlabeled reel she has never dared to run. Calls him 'Mr. Lu'.

persona.zh: 老周：六十多岁，潮声影院看门的，主角祖父的老搭档。嘴硬心软。
persona.en: Old Zhou: in his sixties, caretaker of the Tidesound Cinema and the protagonist's grandfather's old partner. Gruff, soft-hearted.

persona.zh: 程航：21 岁，主角的室友，话多，自认恋爱军师，其实一次也没谈过。
persona.en: Cheng Hang: 21, the protagonist's roommate. Talkative, a self-appointed love strategist who has never dated.

text.zh: 三月，汐川。
text.en: March, Xichuan.

text.zh: 开学第一周。
text.en: The first week of term.

title.zh: 第二章 · 第一场放映

text.zh: 三月第二周。
text.en: The second week of March.

title.zh: 第三章 · 第三个社员

text.zh: 四月。
text.en: April.

text.zh: 四月最后一周。
text.en: The last week of April.

text.zh: 三月。列车沿着海岸线往南开。窗外的海，和七年前一模一样。
text.en: March. The train runs south along the coast. The sea outside the window looks exactly as it did seven years ago.

label.en: "I'm just here to pack up my grandfather's things."

text.zh: ……这样啊。
text.en: …I see.

t.zh: ……这样啊。
t.en: …I see.

t.zh: 那你收拾的时候，小心点放映室。里面的东西，比你以为的要多。
t.en: Then be careful in the booth when you do. There's more in there than you think.

t.zh: 她跳下台子，从我身边走过，没有回头。
t.en: She hops down from the stage and walks past me without looking back.

label.en: "…I came to see its last spring."

text.zh: 最后一个春天……
text.en: Its last spring…

t.zh: 最后一个春天……
t.en: Its last spring…

t.zh: 这句话不错。可以借我用在海报上吗？
t.en: That's a good line. Can I borrow it for the poster?

t.zh: 她笑起来的时候，夕阳刚好落进海里。
t.en: When she smiles, the sun has just slipped into the sea.

label.en: "…Who are you, first?"

text.zh: 我？夏知遥，汐川大学电影社社长。
text.en: Me? Xia Zhiyao. President of the Xichuan University Film Club.

t.zh: 我？夏知遥，汐川大学电影社社长。
t.en: Me? Xia Zhiyao. President of the Xichuan University Film Club.

t.zh: 社员嘛……目前，一个。就是我。
t.en: Members… currently, one. Me.

t.zh: 三月。列车沿着海岸线往南开。窗外的海，和七年前一模一样。
t.en: March. The train runs south along the coast. The sea outside the window looks exactly as it did seven years ago.

t.zh: 七年。我以为自己不会再回来了。
t.en: Seven years. I thought I'd never come back.

t.zh: 父亲去世以后，律师寄来一封信：汐川的老房子归我了。还有一句话，写在信的最后——
t.en: After my father died, the lawyer sent a letter: the old house in Xichuan was mine now. And one more line, at the very end—

t.zh: “潮声影院五月拆除。你祖父的东西，还在放映室。——老周”
t.en: 'The Tidesound Cinema comes down in May. Your grandfather's things are still in the projection booth. —Old Zhou'

t.zh: 汐川站小得只有一个站台。风里有咸味。
t.en: Xichuan Station has only one platform. The wind tastes of salt.

t.zh: 老房子的门锁锈了。院子里那棵枇杷树还在，比记忆里高了很多。
t.en: The lock on the old house has rusted. The loquat tree in the yard is still there, much taller than I remember.

t.zh: 先去影院看看吧。趁天还没黑。
t.en: I'll go see the cinema first. While it's still light.

t.zh: 潮声影院是一座露天影院。白色的银幕背对着海，前面是一排排生锈的铁椅子。夕阳把银幕染成了橙色。
t.en: The Tidesound Cinema is an open-air theater. Its white screen stands with its back to the sea, rows of rusting iron seats before it. The sunset has turned the screen orange.

t.zh: 银幕下面的台子上，站着一个女孩。她对着空无一人的座位，大声地念着什么。
t.en: On the stage beneath the screen stands a girl. She is reading something aloud, at full volume, to rows of empty seats.

t.zh: ……春季放映会，最后一季！每周六晚上七点，潮声影院，免费入场！——不对，太像卖菜的了。
t.en: …The Spring Screenings, final season! Every Saturday, seven p.m., the Tidesound Cinema, free admission!—No. That sounds like a market stall.
…Oh.

t.zh: 你是拆迁办的人吧？我告诉你，五月之前，我们一天也不会搬的！
t.en: You're from the demolition office, right? Let me tell you—until May, we're not moving out a single day early!

t.zh: 我不是拆迁办的。我姓陆。这座影院，是我爷爷开的。
t.en: I'm not from the demolition office. My name's Lu. My grandfather built this cinema.
…Huh?

t.zh: 陆爷爷的孙子？那你——你是来拆它的，还是来救它的？
t.en: Grandpa Lu's grandson? Then you're—are you here to tear it down, or to save it?

text.zh: 转学到汐川大学的第一天，室友程航就把我拖到了社团招新的广场上。
text.en: On my first day at Xichuan University, my roommate Cheng Hang drags me to the club fair in the square.

label.en: Fill in the form on the spot.

text.zh: 真的？！
text.en: Really?!

t.zh: 真的？！
t.en: Really?!

t.zh: 好，陆远，从今天起你就是电影社的第二个社员。工作很多的，你别后悔。
t.en: Okay, Lu Yuan, as of today you're the film club's second member. There's a lot of work. No regrets.

t.zh: 她把表格收好，像是怕我反悔，又看了一遍我的名字。
t.en: She tucks the form away, then reads my name over once more, as if afraid I'd take it back.

label.zh: 说要想想，转身去追沈澄。
label.en: Say you need to think, and go after Shen Cheng.

text.en: …Hey!

t.en: …Hey!

t.zh: 我在广场的另一头追上了沈澄。她没有停下来。
t.en: I catch up with Shen Cheng at the far end of the square. She doesn't stop walking.

t.zh: 有事？
t.en: Something you need?

t.zh: ……好久不见。
t.en: …It's been a long time.

t.zh: 七年。不是“好久”。
t.en: Seven years. Not 'a long time.'

t.zh: 她说完就走了。可我看见，她走到拐角时，回头看了一眼。
t.en: Then she's gone. But at the corner, I see her glance back once.

label.zh: 问季白：放映员是做什么的？
label.en: Ask Ji Bai what a projectionist actually does.

text.zh: 让光穿过胶片，一秒二十四格，打到银幕上。观众看见的是动，其实每一格都是停着的。
text.en: I send light through the film, twenty-four frames a second, onto the screen. The audience sees motion, but every single frame is standing still.

t.zh: 让光穿过胶片，一秒二十四格，打到银幕上。观众看见的是动，其实每一格都是停着的。
t.en: I send light through the film, twenty-four frames a second, onto the screen. The audience sees motion, but every single frame is standing still.

t.zh: ……抱歉，说多了。
t.en: …Sorry. I talked too much.

t.zh: 她一说起胶片就停不下来。所以——你入不入？
t.en: Once she starts on film she can't stop. So—are you in?

t.zh: 我在表格上写了名字。季白在旁边看着，没说话，嘴角好像动了一下。
t.en: I write my name on the form. Ji Bai watches without a word; the corner of her mouth seems to move.

t.zh: 转学到汐川大学的第一天，室友程航就把我拖到了社团招新的广场上。
t.en: On my first day at Xichuan University, my roommate Cheng Hang drags me to the club fair in the square.

t.zh: 听我的，大三转学生想融入，只有一条路：社团。尤其是女生多的社团。
t.en: Trust me. A third-year transfer has one way to fit in: clubs. Especially clubs with lots of girls.

t.zh: 那个摊位就不行了，你看，只有一个人。
t.en: That booth's hopeless, though. Look—one person.

t.zh: 最角落的摊位上，摆着一台老式放映机，一张手画的海报：《春季放映会 · 最后一季》。摊位后面坐着的，是昨天那个女孩。
t.en: At the farthest corner booth sit an old film projector and a hand-drawn poster: 'The Spring Screenings · Final Season.' Behind it sits the girl from yesterday.

t.zh: 啊，陆爷爷的孙子！你也是这个学校的？
t.en: Oh—Grandpa Lu's grandson! You go here too?

t.zh: 太好了。听着，电影社再招不到两个人，学期末就要被撤销了。你来，就还差一个。
t.en: Perfect. Listen—if the film club doesn't get two more members, it's dissolved at the end of term. You join, and we're only one short.

t.zh: 知遥，放映机的片门我调好了。下周六可以用。
t.en: Zhiyao, I've adjusted the projector's gate. It'll be ready next Saturday.

t.zh: 这是季白，研究生，影院的放映员。
t.en: This is Ji Bai, a grad student. She's the cinema's projectionist.

t.zh: 我不是社员。我是被雇来的。……你好，陆同学。
t.en: I'm not a member. I'm hired help. …Hello, Mr. Lu.

t.zh: 一个端着托盘的女孩从摊位前走过，停下了。托盘上是几杯外送的咖啡。
t.en: A girl carrying a tray of takeaway coffees passes the booth, and stops.

t.zh: ……陆远。
t.en: …Lu Yuan.

t.zh: 回来了啊。
t.en: So you're back.

t.zh: 沈澄。七年没见，她一眼就认出了我。
t.en: Shen Cheng. Seven years, and she recognized me at a glance.

t.zh: 我还要送咖啡。
t.en: I've got coffee to deliver.

t.zh: 认识的人？……先不管这个。所以，你入不入社？
t.en: Someone you know? …Never mind. So—are you joining or not?

text.zh: 傍晚下起了雨。我在校门口看见夏知遥抱着一卷海报，一张一张往公告栏上贴。
text.en: It starts raining in the evening. At the school gate I find Xia Zhiyao with an armful of posters, pasting them onto the notice board one by one.

label.en: Hold your umbrella over her.

text.zh: ……都湿透了还撑伞，你傻不傻。
text.en: …We're already soaked and you open an umbrella. Are you an idiot?

t.zh: ……都湿透了还撑伞，你傻不傻。
t.en: …We're already soaked and you open an umbrella. Are you an idiot?

t.zh: 她没有躲开。
t.en: She doesn't step away.

label.en: "Then let's fill it once. I'll help."

text.zh: 说好了啊。说话不算数的人，我会记一辈子的。
text.en: That's a promise. I'll remember anyone who breaks one for the rest of my life.

t.zh: 说好了啊。说话不算数的人，我会记一辈子的。
t.en: That's a promise. I'll remember anyone who breaks one for the rest of my life.

t.zh: 傍晚下起了雨。我在校门口看见夏知遥抱着一卷海报，一张一张往公告栏上贴。
t.en: It starts raining in the evening. At the school gate I find Xia Zhiyao with an armful of posters, pasting them onto the notice board one by one.

t.zh: 看什么？来帮忙啊，社员。
t.en: What are you staring at? Come help, member.

t.zh: 我们贴完最后一张的时候，两个人都湿透了。
t.en: By the time we've put up the last one, we're both soaked.

t.zh: 其实我知道，就算招满了人，影院五月还是要拆。
t.en: Honestly, I know it. Even if we fill the club, the cinema still comes down in May.

t.zh: 可是我想在它拆掉之前，让它再满一次。哪怕就一次。
t.en: But before it does, I want to see it full one more time. Even just once.

text.zh: 沈家的咖啡馆还在海堤边上，招牌换了，门口的风铃没换。
text.en: The Shen family café still sits by the seawall. The sign is new; the wind chime by the door isn't.

label.zh: “热可可，多放一块棉花糖。”——小时候每次来都点这个。
label.en: "Hot cocoa, extra marshmallow." The order you always made as a kid.

text.en: …Okay.

t.en: …Okay.

t.zh: 她转身去做，背对着我站了很久。端上来的时候，杯子里有两块棉花糖。
t.en: She turns to make it and stands with her back to me for a long time. When she brings it over, there are two marshmallows in the cup.

t.zh: 这个你倒是记得。
t.en: That, you remember.

label.en: "Are you angry with me?"

text.zh: 生气？
text.en: Angry?

t.zh: 生气？
t.en: Angry?

t.zh: 生气要力气的。七年，早用完了。
t.en: Being angry takes energy. I used it all up years ago.

t.zh: ……你连那天也忘了吧。
t.en: …You've forgotten that day too, haven't you.

t.zh: 那天？哪一天？
t.en: That day? Which day?

t.zh: 沈家的咖啡馆还在海堤边上，招牌换了，门口的风铃没换。
t.en: The Shen family café still sits by the seawall. The sign is new; the wind chime by the door isn't.

t.zh: ……欢迎光临。要点什么？
t.en: …Welcome. What can I get you?

t.zh: 她的语气，和对任何一个客人都一样。
t.en: Her tone is the same as with any other customer.

text.zh: 潮声影院的放映室在银幕对面的小楼上。我推门进去的时候，季白正对着灯，一格一格地看胶片。
text.en: The Tidesound's projection booth is in the little building facing the screen. When I push the door open, Ji Bai is holding film up to the lamp, studying it frame by frame.

label.en: "Could I see that reel?"

text.zh: ……可以看，不可以放。
text.en: …You can look. You can't run it.

t.zh: ……可以看，不可以放。
t.en: …You can look. You can't run it.

t.zh: 那盘胶片很轻，铁盒上有一道划痕，像是有人用指甲刻下的一个数字：7。
t.en: The reel is light. On its tin there is a scratch, as if someone carved a number with a fingernail: 7.

label.en: "What are you repairing? Can I help?"

text.zh: 那你帮我拿着这一头。别碰到画面。
text.en: Then hold this end for me. Don't touch the picture.

t.zh: 那你帮我拿着这一头。别碰到画面。
t.en: Then hold this end for me. Don't touch the picture.

t.zh: 我们一直修到天黑。她讲每一格的时候，声音比白天轻快很多。
t.en: We work until dark. When she talks about each frame, her voice is far lighter than it was by day.

t.zh: 潮声影院的放映室在银幕对面的小楼上。我推门进去的时候，季白正对着灯，一格一格地看胶片。
t.en: The Tidesound's projection booth is in the little building facing the screen. When I push the door open, Ji Bai is holding film up to the lamp, studying it frame by frame.

t.zh: 陆同学。墙上那些，是你祖父的字。
t.en: Mr. Lu. The writing on the wall there is your grandfather's.

t.zh: 墙上贴满了泛黄的便签：哪台机器哪天换过灯泡，哪部片子哪一卷容易断。最下面一张写着：“第七卷，别放。”
t.en: The wall is covered with yellowed notes: which machine had its bulb changed when, which reel of which film tends to snap. The one at the very bottom says: 'Reel seven. Don't run it.'

t.zh: 仓库里确实有一盘没有标签的胶片。我数过，它在第七个架子上。
t.en: There is a reel with no label in the storeroom. I counted. It's on the seventh shelf.

t.zh: 我一直没放。……因为他说别放。
t.en: I've never run it. …Because he said not to.

text.zh: 兄弟，你出名了。论坛上说转学生一来就到处追女生。
text.en: Buddy, you're famous. The forum says the new transfer has been chasing every girl in sight.

label.en: "…Got it."

text.zh: 这几天，路上遇见的人好像都在看我。
text.en: For days after, everyone I pass seems to be looking at me.

t.zh: 这几天，路上遇见的人好像都在看我。
t.en: For days after, everyone I pass seems to be looking at me.

t.zh: 兄弟，你出名了。论坛上说转学生一来就到处追女生。
t.en: Buddy, you're famous. The forum says the new transfer has been chasing every girl in sight.

t.zh: 我的建议是：这两天低调一点。
t.en: My advice: keep your head down for a couple of days.

text.zh: 周六傍晚。潮声影院的铁椅子被我们擦了一下午，还是锈的。
text.en: Saturday evening. We spent the whole afternoon wiping down the Tidesound's iron chairs. They're still rusty.

label.zh: 跑去放映室，帮季白接片。
label.en: Run to the booth and help Ji Bai splice the film.

text.zh: 按住这里。对，别抖。
text.en: Hold it here. Yes. Don't shake.

t.zh: 按住这里。对，别抖。
t.en: Hold it here. Yes. Don't shake.

t.zh: 她的手很稳。三分钟后，银幕重新亮了起来。
t.en: Her hands are steady. Three minutes later the screen lights up again.

t.zh: ……你的手，比我想的稳。
t.en: …Your hands are steadier than I expected.

label.zh: 跳上台，陪夏知遥对观众说话救场。
label.en: Jump onto the stage and help Zhiyao keep the audience.

text.zh: 各位，趁换片的时间，我们社长讲讲这部电影的幕后故事。
text.en: Everyone—while we change the reel, our president will tell you the story behind this film.

t.zh: 各位，趁换片的时间，我们社长讲讲这部电影的幕后故事。
t.en: Everyone—while we change the reel, our president will tell you the story behind this film.

t.zh: 我？！……好、好吧！这部片子拍的时候，导演其实——
t.en: Me?! …O-okay! When they shot this one, the director actually—

t.zh: 她讲得磕磕绊绊，可五个观众，一个都没走。
t.en: She stumbles through it, but of the five people watching, not one leaves.

t.zh: （小声）……谢了。
t.en: (quietly) …Thanks.

label.zh: 看见沈澄提着空保温桶往外走，追上去送她回家。
label.en: See Shen Cheng leaving with the empty flask, and walk her home.

text.zh: 不看完？
text.en: Not staying to the end?

t.zh: 不看完？
t.en: Not staying to the end?

t.zh: 断片了。正好。
t.en: The film broke. Good timing.

t.zh: ……你小时候，也总是电影放到一半就跑出来找我。
t.en: …When we were kids, you'd always run out halfway through a film to come find me.

t.zh: 一路上她没再说话。到了店门口，她说了声“晚安”，声音比白天软一点。
t.en: She doesn't say another word the whole way. At the café door she says 'good night,' a little softer than by day.

t.zh: 那天之后，我还是去填了表。夏知遥在教学楼门口堵了我三天。
t.en: In the end I filled in the form anyway. Xia Zhiyao staked out the lecture building for three days straight.

t.zh: 周六傍晚。潮声影院的铁椅子被我们擦了一下午，还是锈的。
t.en: Saturday evening. We spent the whole afternoon wiping down the Tidesound's iron chairs. They're still rusty.

t.zh: 你就是老陆的孙子？长得不像他。眼睛像。
t.en: So you're old Lu's grandson? You don't look like him. The eyes, maybe.

t.zh: 放映室的钥匙，你爷爷说过，哪天你回来了就给你。……喏。
t.en: Your grandfather said if you ever came back, I was to give you the booth key. …Here.

t.zh: 七点。来的人一共五个：两对情侣，一个遛狗的大爷。
t.en: Seven o'clock. Five people come in all: two couples and an old man walking his dog.

t.zh: 五个人也是观众！春季放映会，第一场，开始！
t.en: Five people is still an audience! The Spring Screenings, first night—let's begin!

t.zh: ……我妈让我送的。热饮，给看电影的人。
t.en: …My mom told me to bring these. Hot drinks, for the audience.

t.zh: 热可可也有。棉花糖，只放了一块。
t.en: There's cocoa too. Only one marshmallow this time.

t.zh: 银幕亮了。海风把光吹得有点晃。放到一半，放映室那边传来一声闷响——画面停住，烧出一个白洞。
t.en: The screen lights up. The sea wind makes the light waver a little. Halfway through, a dull snap comes from the booth—the picture freezes and a white hole burns through it.

t.zh: 断片了……
t.en: The film broke…

text.zh: 活动室里，夏知遥对着一本账本算了很久。
text.en: In the club room, Xia Zhiyao has been staring at a ledger for a long time.

label.en: "Three thousand. We'll figure it out together."

text.zh: 你有办法？
text.en: You have a plan?

t.zh: 你有办法？
t.en: You have a plan?

t.zh: 老周说，放映室里有我爷爷的旧海报。拿去义卖。
t.en: Old Zhou says the booth is full of my grandfather's old posters. We sell them for charity.

t.zh: ……陆远，你偶尔还挺靠得住的嘛。
t.en: …Lu Yuan, you're actually reliable sometimes.

label.en: "That call just now—that was your mom, wasn't it?"

text.en: …Oh.

t.en: …Oh.

t.zh: 你眼睛真尖。没事，她就是想问我吃饭了没。
t.en: You've got sharp eyes. It's nothing. She just wanted to know if I'd eaten.

t.zh: 她把手机屏幕朝下扣在了桌上。
t.en: She sets the phone face down on the table.

t.zh: 活动室里，夏知遥对着一本账本算了很久。
t.en: In the club room, Xia Zhiyao has been staring at a ledger for a long time.

t.zh: 租发电机、买胶片、印海报……最后一场想放得像样，至少要三千。
t.en: Generator rental, film stock, posters… if the last screening's going to look decent, we need three thousand at least.

t.zh: 她的手机响了。她看了一眼，按掉了。
t.en: Her phone rings. She glances at it and declines the call.

t.zh: ……推销电话。
t.en: …Telemarketer.

t.zh: 那个备注，写的是“妈”。
t.en: The contact name said 'Mom.'

text.zh: 夜里的海堤上，沈澄蹲着喂几只流浪猫。
text.en: On the seawall at night, Shen Cheng is crouched, feeding a few stray cats.

label.en: "…I'm sorry. I can't remember."

text.zh: 嗯。我猜也是。
text.en: Mm. I figured.

t.zh: 嗯。我猜也是。
t.en: Mm. I figured.

t.zh: 没关系。想不起来的话，就别硬想。……说出来就不算了。
t.en: It's fine. If you can't remember, don't force it. …If I tell you, it won't count.

label.en: "Of course I remember."

text.zh: 是吗。那你说说看。
text.en: Really? Then tell me.

t.zh: 是吗。那你说说看。
t.en: Really? Then tell me.

t.zh: 我说不出来。她站起来，拍了拍裙子上的灰。
t.en: I can't. She stands up and brushes the dust off her skirt.

t.zh: 撒谎的时候，你还是会摸耳朵。
t.en: You still touch your ear when you lie.

t.zh: 夜里的海堤上，沈澄蹲着喂几只流浪猫。
t.en: On the seawall at night, Shen Cheng is crouched, feeding a few stray cats.

t.zh: 它们是那只三花的孙子辈。你走的那年，它刚生。
t.en: They're the grandkids of that calico. The year you left, she'd just had her litter.

t.zh: ……你走的那天，你说过一句话。你还记得吗？
t.en: …The day you left, you said something to me. Do you remember?

t.zh: 我拼命地想。只想得起那天下雨，站台上很多人。
t.en: I search my memory as hard as I can. All I recall is that it rained, and the platform was crowded.

text.zh: 图书馆三楼最里面，季白在翻一本很旧的胶片修复手册。
text.en: On the library's third floor, in the farthest corner, Ji Bai is leafing through a very old film-restoration manual.

label.zh: 讲小时候爷爷带你在放映室过夜的事。
label.en: Tell her how your grandfather let you spend nights in the booth as a kid.

text.zh: ……原来放映室那张小床，是给你的。
text.en: …So the little cot in the booth was for you.

t.zh: ……原来放映室那张小床，是给你的。
t.en: …So the little cot in the booth was for you.

t.zh: 我一直以为，是给他自己的。
t.en: I always assumed it was his.

label.zh: “你为什么这么在意那盘胶片？”
label.en: "Why do you care so much about that reel?"

text.zh: ……因为它是唯一一盘，我不知道里面是什么的。
text.en: …Because it's the only reel I don't know the contents of.

t.zh: ……因为它是唯一一盘，我不知道里面是什么的。
t.en: …Because it's the only reel I don't know the contents of.

t.zh: 修胶片的人，最怕的就是这个。
t.en: For someone who restores film, that's the most frightening thing there is.

t.zh: 图书馆三楼最里面，季白在翻一本很旧的胶片修复手册。
t.en: On the library's third floor, in the farthest corner, Ji Bai is leafing through a very old film-restoration manual.

t.zh: 陆同学。你祖父……是个什么样的人？
t.en: Mr. Lu. What was your grandfather like?

t.zh: 我修他的胶片两年了。每一盘的接缝都整整齐齐，只有一盘，接得乱七八糟。像是手在抖。
t.en: I've been restoring his film for two years. Every splice is perfectly neat—except on one reel. That one's a mess. As if his hands were shaking.

t.zh: 第七卷。那盘没有标签的。
t.en: Reel seven. The one with no label.

text.zh: 四月初，学生处来了通知：电影社月底前凑不齐三个人，就撤销，影院的场地使用证明也一起作废。
text.en: Early April, a notice from Student Affairs: if the film club doesn't have three members by month's end, it's dissolved—and its permit to use the cinema goes with it.

label.en: Go ask Ji Bai in the booth.

text.zh: 我？我说过，我不是社员。
text.en: Me? I told you, I'm not a member.

t.zh: 我？我说过，我不是社员。
t.en: Me? I told you, I'm not a member.

t.zh: 现在开始是。你修了两年它的胶片，它的最后一场，你不在名单上，说不过去。
t.en: Starting now, you are. You've spent two years restoring its film. It wouldn't be right if your name wasn't on the list for its last show.

t.zh: ……你很会说话。
t.en: …You're good with words.

t.zh: 好。不过放映员的活儿，我照样要拿工钱。
t.en: Fine. But I still expect to be paid for the projection work.

label.en: Go ask Shen Cheng at the café.

text.zh: 电影社？
text.en: The film club?

t.zh: 电影社？
t.en: The film club?

t.zh: ……潮声影院的最后一场，我本来就要去的。
t.en: …I was going to be at the Tidesound's last show anyway.

t.zh: 表给我。
t.en: Give me the form.

t.zh: 她填表的时候，把我的名字那一栏看了很久。
t.en: As she fills it in, she looks at the line with my name on it for a long time.

hint.en: She won't give you the time of day yet

label.en: Drag your roommate Cheng Hang in to make up the numbers.

text.zh: 电影社？女生多吗？——三个？！而且都……兄弟，我入了！
text.en: The film club? Lots of girls?—Three of them?! And they're all… Buddy, I'm in!

t.zh: 电影社？女生多吗？——三个？！而且都……兄弟，我入了！
t.en: The film club? Lots of girls?—Three of them?! And they're all… Buddy, I'm in!

t.zh: ……陆远，你就找了这么个人？
t.en: …Lu Yuan, this is who you found?

t.zh: 算了，能签字就行。
t.en: Fine. As long as he can sign his name.

t.zh: 四月初，学生处来了通知：电影社月底前凑不齐三个人，就撤销，影院的场地使用证明也一起作废。
t.en: Early April, a notice from Student Affairs: if the film club doesn't have three members by month's end, it's dissolved—and its permit to use the cinema goes with it.

t.zh: 还差一个。就差一个。
t.en: One more. Just one more.

t.zh: 义卖的钱够了，可是没有人，钱也没用。
t.en: The poster sale raised the money—but without members, money's no use.

t.zh: 陆远，你帮我去问一个人。谁都行。
t.en: Lu Yuan, go ask someone for me. Anyone.

text.zh: 中午，夏知遥拉我上了教学楼天台。她带了两个饭团。
text.en: At noon Xia Zhiyao drags me up to the roof of the teaching building. She's brought two rice balls.

label.en: "What about you?"

text.zh: 我啊……
text.en: Me…

t.zh: 我啊……
t.en: Me…

t.zh: 我要回家了。我妈一个人，身体不太好。
t.en: I'm going home. My mom's on her own, and her health isn't great.

t.zh: 所以影院的最后一场，也是我的最后一场。……别告诉别人。
t.en: So the cinema's last show is my last show too. …Don't tell anyone.

label.en: "Depends on whether you do."

text.en: …Hmph.

t.en: …Hmph.

t.zh: 笨蛋。饭团要掉了。
t.en: Idiot. You're about to drop your rice ball.

t.zh: 中午，夏知遥拉我上了教学楼天台。她带了两个饭团。
t.en: At noon Xia Zhiyao drags me up to the roof of the teaching building. She's brought two rice balls.

t.zh: 从这里能看见潮声影院的银幕。看，那个白点。
t.en: You can see the Tidesound's screen from here. Look—that white dot.

t.zh: ……陆远，毕业以后，你会留在汐川吗？
t.en: …Lu Yuan, after graduation—will you stay in Xichuan?

t.zh: 我想起那个被她按掉的电话。
t.en: I think of the call she declined.

text.zh: 打烊以后，沈澄把一张照片推到我面前。照片上是两个小孩，坐在潮声影院的第一排。
text.en: After closing, Shen Cheng slides a photo across to me. Two kids, sitting in the front row of the Tidesound.

label.en: "This time, I'll keep my word."

text.zh: ……七年才兑现的约，算吗？
text.en: …Does a promise count if it takes seven years?

t.zh: ……七年才兑现的约，算吗？
t.en: …Does a promise count if it takes seven years?

t.zh: 算吧。
t.en: I suppose it does.

label.en: "I'm sorry I made you wait so long."

text.zh: 我没在等。
text.en: I wasn't waiting.

t.zh: 我没在等。
t.en: I wasn't waiting.

t.zh: ……只是每年春天，都会去看一眼影院还在不在。
t.en: …I just went to check every spring whether the cinema was still there.

t.zh: 打烊以后，沈澄把一张照片推到我面前。照片上是两个小孩，坐在潮声影院的第一排。
t.en: After closing, Shen Cheng slides a photo across to me. Two kids, sitting in the front row of the Tidesound.

t.zh: 这是你走之前一个月拍的。你爷爷拍的。
t.en: This was taken a month before you left. Your grandfather took it.

t.zh: 我想起来了。那天放的是一部很老的片子，我睡着了，醒来的时候，她在哭。
t.en: I remember now. They were showing a very old film, I fell asleep, and when I woke up she was crying.

t.zh: 你那天说：“等这座影院要关的时候，最后一场，我一定回来陪你看。”
t.en: That day you said: 'When this cinema closes, I'll come back for its last show. I'll watch it with you. I promise.'

text.zh: 影院仓库里很暗。季白站在第七个架子前面，手里拿着那盘胶片。
text.en: The cinema's storeroom is dark. Ji Bai stands before the seventh shelf with the reel in her hands.

label.en: "Before the last show, we'll watch it together."

text.zh: ……一起？
text.en: …Together?

t.zh: ……一起？
t.en: …Together?

t.zh: 好。那我先把它修好。一格都不会少。
t.en: All right. Then I'll restore it first. Not a single frame missing.

label.en: "He said not to run it. So let's not."

text.en: …Mm.

t.en: …Mm.

t.zh: 她把胶片放回了架子上，动作很轻，像放下一个睡着的人。
t.en: She sets the reel back on the shelf, gently, like laying down someone asleep.

t.zh: 影院仓库里很暗。季白站在第七个架子前面，手里拿着那盘胶片。
t.en: The cinema's storeroom is dark. Ji Bai stands before the seventh shelf with the reel in her hands.

t.zh: 影院拆了，这盘胶片就没有地方放了。
t.en: Once the cinema's gone, there'll be nowhere left to run this reel.

t.zh: 陆同学，你是他的孙子。放不放，应该你来定。
t.en: Mr. Lu, you're his grandson. Whether it gets run should be your decision.

title.en: The Night Before the Last Show

text.zh: 四月最后一个周五。明天，是潮声影院的最后一场放映。下周一，拆迁队就会进场。
text.en: The last Friday of April. Tomorrow is the Tidesound Cinema's final screening. Next Monday, the demolition crew moves in.

label.zh: 去银幕下面。夏知遥一定还在排练。
label.en: Go to the stage below the screen. Zhiyao will still be rehearsing.

text.zh: ……你来了。
text.en: …You came.

t.zh: ……你来了。
t.en: …You came.

t.zh: 我一个人练了一晚上开场白。每次念到“最后一季”，就念不下去。
t.en: I've been practicing the opening speech all night on my own. Every time I get to 'final season,' I can't go on.

t.zh: 你知道的。这也是我的最后一季。
t.en: You know why. It's my final season too.

label.zh: 去海堤。沈澄说过，她每年春天都会去看影院还在不在。
label.en: Go to the seawall. Shen Cheng said she checks every spring that the cinema's still there.

text.zh: ……我就知道。
text.en: …I knew it.

t.zh: ……我就知道。
t.en: …I knew it.

t.zh: 明天。七年前你说的那一场，就是明天。
t.en: Tomorrow. The show you promised seven years ago—it's tomorrow.

t.zh: 社员证我带着。明天我坐第一排，你别想跑。
t.en: I've got my membership card. I'm sitting in the front row tomorrow, so don't you dare run off.

label.en: Go to the booth. The light's still on.

text.zh: 我修好了。第七卷。……要看吗？
text.en: I've finished it. Reel seven. …Do you want to see it?

t.zh: 我修好了。第七卷。……要看吗？
t.en: I've finished it. Reel seven. …Do you want to see it?

t.zh: 你说过，要一起看。我一个人的时候，一格都没看。
t.en: You said we'd watch it together. On my own, I haven't looked at a single frame.

t.zh: 做了社员以后，我第一次有了放映室的钥匙。……今晚，我想用它。
t.en: Since becoming a member, I have my own key to the booth for the first time. …Tonight I wanted to use it.

label.zh: 回老房子。明天还要早起。
label.en: Go back to the old house. It's an early start tomorrow.

text.zh: 院子里的枇杷树沙沙地响。我躺在小时候的床上，听了一夜的海。
text.en: The loquat tree rustles in the yard. I lie in my childhood bed and listen to the sea all night.

t.zh: 院子里的枇杷树沙沙地响。我躺在小时候的床上，听了一夜的海。
t.en: The loquat tree rustles in the yard. I lie in my childhood bed and listen to the sea all night.

t.zh: 四月最后一个周五。明天，是潮声影院的最后一场放映。下周一，拆迁队就会进场。
t.en: The last Friday of April. Tomorrow is the Tidesound Cinema's final screening. Next Monday, the demolition crew moves in.

t.zh: 海报贴满了半个汐川。夏知遥说，明天至少会来两百个人。
t.en: Posters cover half of Xichuan. Zhiyao says at least two hundred people will come tomorrow.

t.zh: 海报最上面印着一行字：“来看它最后一个春天。”——是我第一天在这里说的话。
t.en: Across the top of every poster is one line: 'Come see its last spring.' The words I said here on my first day.

t.zh: 两百个？我在论坛上发了帖，保底三百。别谢我，谢我的号召力。
t.en: Two hundred? I posted on the forum. Three hundred, minimum. Don't thank me—thank my reach.

t.zh: 你爷爷要是看见了，得哭。
t.en: If your grandfather could see this, he'd cry.

t.zh: 去吧。今晚，总有人在等你。
t.en: Go on. Tonight, someone's bound to be waiting for you.

t.zh: 今晚，我想去见的是——
t.en: Tonight, the one I want to see is—

text.zh: 明天的最后一场，你会站在她身边，陪她把那句开场白念完。——夏知遥线，敬请期待。
text.en: At tomorrow's last show you'll stand beside her and help her get through that opening line. —Xia Zhiyao's route, coming soon.

text.zh: 七年前的那个约，明天就要兑现了。——沈澄线，即将开放。
text.en: The promise from seven years ago will be kept tomorrow. —Shen Cheng's route, coming soon.

text.zh: 放映机转起来了。第七卷的第一格，是一片海。——季白线，即将开放。
text.en: The projector starts to turn. The first frame of reel seven is the sea. —Ji Bai's route, coming soon.

text.zh: 最后一场放映，你坐在最后一排。散场的时候，银幕上的光一点一点暗下去。春天就这样过去了。（普通结局）
text.en: At the last show you sit in the back row. As the crowd leaves, the light on the screen fades bit by bit. And so the spring passes. (Normal ending)

text.zh: 夏知遥在社团群里，第一次叫了你的名字。
text.en: In the club chat, Xia Zhiyao calls you by name for the first time.

text.zh: 沈澄的咖啡馆，那几天打烊总比平时晚一个小时。
text.en: Those nights, Shen Cheng's café always closes an hour late.

text.zh: 放映室的灯，那几周每晚都亮到很晚。
text.en: For those weeks, the light in the booth burns late every night.

text.zh: 这个春天过得很快。你还说不清，自己最想见的是谁。
text.en: The spring goes by fast. You still can't say who you most want to see.
